component.name: Quillpane
component.summary: Edit local Markdown notes with split view and version history

description.p: Quillpane (formerly Markpad) is a small native Markdown notepad built with Go and the system webview. It keeps ordinary files local, without Electron, accounts, or telemetry.

ul.li: Split view: Editor, side-by-side split, and preview modes with resizable divider
Version history: every save creates a snapshot you can browse, preview, and restore
Session restore: all notes, drafts, and favorites survive app close
Formatting toolbar with bold, italic, headings, code, tables, lists, links, and more
Find in editor with wrap-around search
Open individual files and switch quickly with the command palette
Current-file search and synchronized Markdown split scrolling
External-change protection before overwriting files edited by another application
Detailed guided tour from Help and recognizable file-type symbols
Auto-list continuation for bullets, numbered lists, and task lists
Open any text file: Markdown, plain text, JSON, YAML, Python, Go, JS, HTML, CSS, and more
Favorites, drag-and-drop reorder, file type icons, word count, reading time

screenshot.caption: A new local Markdown note in Quillpane on Linux

description.p: A clearer Help page with version badges, updates, local storage details, and project and creator links.
Detailed Help tour, synchronized Split scrolling, file-type symbols and colors, improved syntax coverage, and removal of folder workspaces.
Visible Help and verified updates; synchronized platform packages and original product icon.
Native preview clipboard copying and Help release checks with guided update downloads.
Quillpane public-name migration with the verified custom domain canonical; existing Markpad executable, data paths, package identifiers, release URLs, and logo remain compatible.
Cleaner native Linux chrome without the duplicate GTK application menu, plus a subtle frameless-window edge and sharper window controls.
Linux WebKitGTK rendering compatibility plus an automated native-window smoke test that verifies visible application content before release.
Incremental CodeMirror source editing, lazy language modes, bounded relative Markdown image loading, prose-first source wrapping, and exact navigation through wrapped notes.

Responsive source viewers, strict semantic design system, custom window chrome, stable overlays, viewport-safe menus, modern Markdown and Mermaid diagrams, Git-style history diffs, improved syntax highlighting, keyboard settings, and unified product assets.
Workspace Lite folder browsing, fast file switching, bounded full-workspace search, confirmed file deletion, external-change save protection, direct draft filing, and a typed React frontend.
Terminal installer, visual layout refinements, and distribution packaging manifests.
Real-Time Sidebar Outline (Table of Contents), memory optimizations (disabled JIT, tuned GCPercent), sidebar transitions, and exit flow fixes.
Version history, auto-list continuation, external links open in browser, UX refinements.
